# Apache Ossie schema

`ossie-schema.json` is the JSON Schema of the Apache Ossie core metadata spec (draft `0.2.0.dev0`), copied unchanged from
https://github.com/apache/ossie/blob/main/core-spec/ossie-schema.json (Apache License 2.0, Copyright The Apache Software
Foundation). It is test data: the catalog export is validated against it so an exported model is a real Ossie document.
Replace it when the Ossie spec moves.
